about.title: About us
about.intro: We build elegant landing pages for professional affiliate marketers.

sections.p: Affiliate marketers spend their time finding great products and writing honest reviews. We give them a premium page with their own name that gathers all their picks from the world’s biggest stores, with short reviews that build trust and raise conversions.
Design, speed, mobile layout, search engine optimisation and click tracking. You focus on choosing products and writing reviews.
Visitors are sent straight to your own affiliate link. We never replace your tracking tag and we never take a share of your commissions.

hero.title: The home base for affiliate marketers who sell through trust
hero.text: Primeshelf turns a list of affiliate links into a premium storefront with your name on it: fast, beautiful, honest and measurable. We handle the technology so you can do what actually earns: finding great products and telling people the truth about them.

story.title: Built for the people behind the recommendations
p: Great affiliate marketers are curators. They test products, compare options and write the honest notes that help someone decide. Yet most of them were stuck with plain link lists that looked the same as everyone else's and told visitors nothing.

We built Primeshelf to give that work the stage it deserves: a storefront that feels like a brand, product pages with real reviews, collections, built-in disclosures and analytics that show which recommendations actually move people. Your links go straight to the stores, and every commission stays yours.

items.p: Visitors go straight to your own affiliate link. We never replace your tracking tag or take a share of what you earn.
Reviews with real pros and cons, clear disclosures and accurate prices build the trust that turns visitors into buyers.
Pages are optimised to load in a blink on any phone, because every second of waiting costs clicks.
Typography, spacing and themes are designed with the care of a premium brand, so your page never looks like a template.
English, French and Arabic with true right-to-left layouts, so you can speak to your audience in their own words.
We collect only what's needed to run your page and measure it, and we never sell your data or your visitors' data.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before you start.

sections.p: A platform for affiliate marketers. You create a luxury landing page with your name that shows your offers from Amazon, Walmart, Target and other stores. Each product gets a review page and a buy button that sends visitors to your affiliate link.

sections.h: How do I get my page link?
sections.p: When you sign up you choose your page name and link, for example yoursite.com/your-name. You can change it later from Page design in your dashboard.

sections.h: Does the platform take part of my commission?
sections.p: No. Visitors go directly to the affiliate link you added, and the store pays your commission under its own program.

sections.h: Can I see how many clicks I get?
sections.p: Yes. Your dashboard shows views, clicks and click-through rate for every offer and for the last 30 days.

sections.h: Do I need an affiliate disclosure?
sections.p: Programs such as Amazon Associates and FTC rules require it, so a disclosure appears by default at the bottom of your page. You can edit its text.
Your page can be in English, Arabic or French, with full right-to-left layout for Arabic.

items.q: What is Primeshelf?
items.a: Primeshelf is a platform for affiliate marketers. You create a premium landing page with your name that showcases your offers from Amazon, Walmart, Target and other major stores. Each product gets its own review page and a buy button that sends visitors to your affiliate link.

items.q: Is it free to start?
items.a: Yes. You can create your page, add offers and share your link for free. You only need your own affiliate links from the programs you have joined.

items.q: How do I get my page link?
items.a: When you sign up you choose your page name and link, for example primeshelf.store/your-name. You can change it later from Page design in your dashboard.

items.q: Which stores can I promote?
items.a: Amazon, Walmart, Target, eBay, Best Buy, AliExpress, Etsy, The Home Depot, Temu, Sephora and Wayfair are recognised automatically with their logos and colours. You can also add links from other stores.

items.q: Can I customise how my page looks?
items.a: Yes. Choose a theme, accent colour, fonts, avatar, cover image and social links from Page design. Every offer automatically becomes a polished product card that matches your style.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes. Connect a domain you own from any provider in the Domain section of your dashboard. We show you the exact DNS records to add and verify the connection automatically.

items.q: Which languages are supported?
items.a: Your page can be in English, French or Arabic, with a full right-to-left layout for Arabic.

items.q: Can I publish articles and reviews?
items.a: Yes. Each offer has its own review page with highlights, specifications, pros, cons and a verdict, and you can publish full articles on your page to rank in search and guide your visitors.

items.q: Does Primeshelf take part of my commission?
items.a: No. Visitors go directly to the affiliate link you added, and the store pays your commission under its own program. We never replace your tracking tag.

items.q: How are clicks tracked?
items.a: Every buy button passes through a fast redirect that counts the click and sends the visitor to your affiliate link. Your dashboard shows views, clicks and click-through rate for each offer.

items.q: Can I see where my traffic comes from?
items.a: Yes. Analytics break down visits and clicks by source, such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube or search, so you know which channels actually convert.

items.q: Can I add Meta or TikTok pixels?
items.a: Yes. Add your own Meta Pixel and TikTok Pixel IDs in the dashboard to measure your campaigns and build audiences.

items.q: Do I need an affiliate disclosure?
items.a: Programs such as Amazon Associates and the FTC require one, so a disclosure appears by default on your page. You can edit its wording to match your voice.

items.q: Will my page follow affiliate program rules?
items.a: Pages are designed around common program requirements: direct affiliate links, visible disclosures and no hidden redirects. You remain responsible for your content, prices and claims, so always check each program's current terms.

items.q: What content is not allowed?
items.a: Misleading claims, counterfeit products, illegal items and content that breaks our Acceptable Use Policy are not allowed. Pages that break the rules can be unpublished.

items.q: How do you handle my data?
items.a: We collect only what's needed to run your page and measure its performance. We never sell personal data. Read our Privacy Policy for the details.

items.q: Can I work with a team?
items.a: Yes. Invite team members to help manage your page. Their changes can require your approval before going live, and you'll be notified of every request.

items.q: I forgot my password. What should I do?
items.a: Use "Forgot password" on the login page. We'll email you a secure link to choose a new password.

items.q: Can I change my page link later?
items.a: Yes, from Page design in your dashboard. Remember to update the link anywhere you've already shared it.

items.q: How do I contact support?
items.a: Write to us from the Contact page or by email. We usually reply within one business day.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: The rules for using Primeshelf: your account, your content, affiliate programs and our responsibilities.

sections.p: You are responsible for the information in your account and for keeping your password safe.

You must publish honest information about products, respect the terms of the affiliate programs you join (such as Amazon Associates, Walmart Affiliates or Target Partners) and display an affiliate disclosure.
Using trademarks or images without the right to do so, or publishing misleading or illegal content, is not allowed.
We may suspend or close any page or account that breaks these terms.
We may update these terms. Continuing to use the platform means you accept the updated version.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What information we collect, why we collect it, who we share it with and the rights you have.

sections.p: We keep your account data (name and email) to run your dashboard.
We only record aggregated statistics (daily views and clicks) without storing personal data about visitors.
When a visitor clicks a buy button they are sent to the store’s website, where that store’s privacy policy applies.
You can ask us to delete your data at any time by contacting us.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: The cookies Primeshelf uses, why we use them and how you can control them.

sections.p: We use a session cookie to keep you logged in to your dashboard, and a cookie to remember your language.
We do not place advertising or tracking cookies of our own on marketer pages.
When a visitor follows an affiliate link, the store may set its own cookies to credit the sale to the marketer. Those cookies are controlled by the store.
You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies will log you out.

disclosure.title: Affiliate disclosure
disclosure.intro: How affiliate links on marketers' pages work and what that means for you.

sections.p: Pages created on the platform are run by independent marketers. When you buy through their links, they may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
Prices and availability are set by the store and can change at any time. Always check the final price on the store’s website.
Reviews are the opinion of each marketer. The platform does not sell products and is not affiliated with the stores shown.
Store names and logos belong to their owners and are used only to identify where a product is sold.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.intro: What is and isn't allowed on Primeshelf, so the platform stays honest and safe for everyone.

sections.p: Do not publish fake reviews, fake discounts or false claims about products.
Respect the rules of every affiliate program you use, including rules about how prices and logos may be shown.
Do not promote illegal, dangerous or adult products, or anything the store itself forbids.
Do not use the platform for spam, phishing, malware or to impersonate another person or brand.
